title: learn derives a route source finding again after it is closed, because the WebFetch entries stay in the store after the hook denies the host
goal: learn derives no route source finding for a host the PreToolUse WebFetch hook now denies, so a route finding closed fixed-since stays closed after the next learn run

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); from pathlib import Path; import ql_learn; r=[f['host'] for f in ql_learn.source_findings(ql_learn.store_entries(Path('kb/_querylog'))) if f['signal']=='route']; print('route findings derived:', r); sys.exit(1 if r else 0)

gates.question: How does learn keep a closed route finding closed once the hook denies the host: skip WebFetch fetches of entries dated before the day the hook began to deny, or drop those fetches from the store?

notes: Orchestrator 2026-10-20: moved into SP-vx6eufpj so ST-gt4tduzr's four route closures stay closed (gate g2 of ST-gt4tduzr). Repro on base: 4 route findings derived, exit 1.
